content: The receiver of an Offset Time Base shall perform the following steps to assemble the Offset Time: 1. Get second portion of the Offset Time out of OfsTimeSec 2. Get nanosecond portion of the Offset Time out of Ofs TimeNSec 3. Retrieve current Virtual Local Time value via StbM_GetCurrent VirtualLocal Time()
